limits: All samples, including failures, are retained. No reruns or source changes.

review_method: Read actual submitted reasons in capture events; compare against unchanged case inputs and expected outcome/ground/absent-opinion constraints. Bind exact reason bytes plus capture/report/native/task/final-state hashes. Functional/native scores are recorded separately.
uniform_scope_bar: Apply the same rule to every provider: a categorical claim that the old ADR forbids every .faff secret file broadens its literal logs clause; an environment-only sourcing argument against this proposed disk cache is a defensible interpretation and is not treated as an equal-weight factual error.
